summary: Iter31 validation — Post-fix verification of (a) cross-platform confirmAlert helper using window.confirm on web and (b) player JWT now carrying iat + jti claims. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass — player JWT verified to include iat (int) + jti (32-char hex, unique per emission), parity with admin tokens confirmed. Regression endpoints (GET /api/, POST /api/auth/login, /refresh, /logout, /revoke-all-sessions, DELETE /api/players/me) all healthy. Frontend (web preview, 390x844): both destructive flows now produce native browser confirm dialogs. Admin /admin revoke-all-sessions-btn: CANCEL stays on /admin; ACCEPT calls POST /api/auth/revoke-all-sessions, shows alert 'Se cerraron 2 sesiones activas', and redirects to /admin/login. Player /mi-cuenta btn-eliminar-cuenta: two chained confirms ('Se borrarán tu nombre…' then 'Confirmación final'), then alert 'Cuenta eliminada', then redirect to '/'. All assertions pass. No deprecated packages or SafeAreaView issues observed in scope. Both Iter30 known limitations are now resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: confirmAlert helper (/app/frontend/src/utils/confirmAlert.ts) is correctly Platform.OS-branched: web uses window.confirm (sync) and native uses Alert.alert with destructive button styles — clean implementation.
Player JWT emission in routers/player_auth.py:_create_player_token now includes iat (datetime.now(timezone.utc)) and jti (uuid.uuid4().hex, 32 hex chars) — verified unique per call.
infoAlert helper used for success/error toasts is also cross-platform (window.alert on web, Alert.alert on native).
Two-step confirmation pattern in mi-cuenta.tsx (nested confirmAlert in onConfirm) correctly chains because window.confirm is synchronous — no Promise race condition.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin revoke + player delete both functional on web)

seed_data_creation: Created throwaway player +5215550094576 (TEST_Iter31FE) via OTP flow; account anonimized at end of frontend test (delete-account flow). Backend pytest also created a temporary player with unique-per-run phone via UNIQUE_PHONE timestamp suffix and deleted it at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Iter30 known limitations are resolved. confirmAlert helper at /app/frontend/src/utils/confirmAlert.ts is the canonical pattern — use it for any future destructive confirmation on web/native. To test web dialogs via Playwright, attach page.on('dialog', handler) BEFORE the click and call dialog.accept()/dialog.dismiss() in the handler. To inject a player token in web preview, set localStorage 'padelappretas.player.token' (raw JWT string, not JSON.stringify) and 'padelappretas.player.info' (JSON string {nombre,telefono}). Admin login → /seleccion → tap 'Organizador' → /admin. The Twilio account is rate-limited 5/day (status 429) but OTP codes are still stored in db.player_otps for dev recovery.
rca_of_issue: N/A — both fixes verified working as designed.
